characters.name: Peter Christen Asbjørnsen
characters.description: A portrait of Peter Christen Asbjørnsen, who lived in 19th-century Norway. He was of medium build and carried an intellectual appearance, typically dressed in period-appropriate attire such as a formal suit with a vest and a cravat, characteristic of a person of scholarly pursuits. Asbjørnsen had a gentle but perceptive expression, indicative of his deep interest in folklore, science, and practical studies. His hair was neatly styled, aligning with the fashion of his era. He exuded an air of quiet authority and curiosity, fitting for someone who contributed significantly to Norwegian culture and science.
